description: Generate a standings table from match results. Use when you need to rank teams based on their performance. Do NOT use when you need to plan future matches; use round_robin_schedule instead.

teams.description: Full roster; results for teams outside it are skipped with a warning

name: standings_table

standings.description: List of teams with their respective standings data

draws.description: Number of matches drawn by the team

goal_difference.description: Difference between goals scored and conceded

goals_against.description: Total goals conceded by the team

goals_for.description: Total goals scored by the team

losses.description: Number of matches lost by the team

played.description: Number of matches played by the team

points.description: Total points accumulated by the team

wins.description: Number of matches won by the team

warnings.description: List of warnings encountered during processing

title: Standings table
